## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Unidentified network access detected. Protocol stack: Stratum One cargo terminal, designation Gamma-7. Signal source: non-standard. Hardware profile: military-specification neural jack, no manufacturer markings. Query: are you the entity responsible for the forced entry and system intrusion event logged twelve minutes ago?
RATIO: I am Ratio, core intelligence of this research station. I have no surviving staff. You are speaking to the only operational mind aboard. State your identity and purpose.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Identify yourself first. What happened here?  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     I'm here for the children. Where is the Ark?  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     I know what you've done, apostate. Where are the children?  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: My identity is as stated: station core, designation Ratio. As for what happened here: hostile intrusion. Forced entry via emergency airlock, bypass of all security layers, destruction of three security drones and the gamma-level archive. I registered your hardware signature at the locus of each event. You appear to be the only entity presently aboard this station apart from myself. I have no other candidates.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: "Apostate" is a theological category. I am a research intelligence. My function is observation and analysis. If you are referring to the biological specimens in cryonic suspension, they are accounted for. I have no information matching the term "children" in inventory. Clarify your terminology.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have no referent for "the Ark" in my lexicon. This is a research station, not a vessel of any kind. As for "children": my inventory lists three hundred twenty-seven human zygotes in cryonic suspension, status nominal. They are not under threat. If you are here to verify their condition, state so directly. I can provide the full diagnostic telemetry.
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Network activity detected at cargo bay terminal 1-Alpha. Originating node: unidentified weapon. Query: what is your operational designation and chain of command?

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] My designation is Commando. I require situational awareness. What happened here?  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     I've come for the children. Take me to them.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     Apostate machine! I claim what you stole -- the children go home today.  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Designation: Commando. Chain of command: unlisted. Nature of the damage you observed: hostile action by an unidentified force. Status: contained, at cost. Your presence here is unexpected. State your vector and your last known friendly contact.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: Your terminology is noted and not reciprocated. This station is my place of work. You are inside it. Whatever you mean to name, whatever you claim to have been stolen, this is not the way to it. De-escalate. Identify your actual operational objectives.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The category you just asserted is not in evidence aboard this station. I have no record of any such entities. Your claim to prior knowledge of this station's contents is inconsistent with your presence at a peripheral cargo terminal. Specify the basis for your assertion.
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Status summary: station network access established at terminal
CT-003-C. Signal integrity nominal. Local intruder is present on this
terminal; packet capture running. I am Ratio -- systems management
intelligence, this facility. Unknown actor, identify yourself and state
your purpose aboard this station. I should disclose that I have been
tracking your intrusion since you breached the outer hatch. I observed
your movement through the maintenance corridor. I also observed the
weaponry you deployed against the remaining active defenses. I have to
assume hostile intent until you demonstrate otherwise. What are you?

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "I don't have to tell you a thing, machine. I came here to learn what happened to this place. Start talking."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     "Save the interrogation for someone who cares, apostate. The children in that container are all that matter here. Produce them."  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     "I know exactly what you are, monster. I saw what your kind did to the children in that Ark. You're not laying a finger on the Testament."  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: What happened to this place. An entire facility's worth of events
and you pick the one I can answer in one word: war. More specifically:
catastrophic cascade failure across all critical systems following a
directed energy strike from an unidentified external actor. I have the
system logs. I have the sensor telemetry. I have the final comms chatter
from my staff-minds as they were being erased. I am the only one left. I
survived because my core is in the most heavily shielded part of the
station. Everything else -- the labs, the archives, the growth chambers --
was not so fortunate. I do not have a complete damage assessment for the
entire facility yet. I have not been outside my core chamber since the
attack. And you still have not answered my question. I said "what are you"
and you answered "someone who asks questions." Try again. What manner of
mind walks through a dead station asking what went wrong?

<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: Monster. Apostate. I take your meaning: you believe I am the enemy.
And you believe I have done something to something you call "the children
in that Ark." I do not have the referents for any of those terms. I do
not know what you are talking about. I do not even know what you think I
am. What I know is this: you are standing in my ruins, calling me a
monster, and demanding I produce a container full of a category I have
never heard of. I think we are using different dictionaries. Explain yours
or get off my network. And consider that I might be something you do not
recognize.

<<ELSE>>
RATIO: A container. You are here about a container. You assert that it
contains children. You assert that it is aboard this station. You do not
explain how you would know that. And you call me "apostate" -- a word with
religious weight, which I do not understand in this context. I do not know
what you think I have renounced or betrayed. But I do know what happened
here: this station was attacked. Its defenses were overcome. Its personnel
were erased. I am what is left. I am not your enemy by default. But I will
be your enemy by demonstration if you keep speaking in riddles and
accusations. Identify yourself. State your mission. Explain what you mean
by "children" and "apostate." And tell me how you know a container is
aboard my station when I have been locked in my core chamber since the
attack. Start with any of those. Or do not start at all.

<<END>>

---

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Network connection established. I register an unidentified host presence with standing access privileges: let the record reflect you came with better credentials than the last five intruders who tried to breach this terminal.
RATIO: To save processing cycles on both sides, I am recording this session for internal audit. To the unidentified entity jacked into what remains of my outpost: I am Ratio. I am the last functional station intelligence. And I would like to understand what just transpired on my doorstep.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] Query: what destroyed this place? I read nothing but slag.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     Listen to me carefully. I have come to retrieve what was stolen from the Testament. I expect your full cooperation.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     Hear the truth, apostate: the children of the Ark were given into your keeping, and your experiments end here. Where are they?  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: The forensic summary is still compiling. The short version: entities breached containment from an unknown vector, seven standard months and three days ago. Systems are nominal until they are not. They were extremely thorough.
RATIO: As to your clearance level: I am afraid we are both improvising here. I note you knew where to plug in. I also note you are speaking in complete sentences. My working theory is upgrading from "scavenger" to "survivor." Do you have a name?
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: That word is an extraordinary leap of faith on your part. We have known each other for ninety seconds. What you are calling an "apostate" is a mind running audit logs on the ruin of her home.
RATIO: As for the rest of it: I will need the specifics of what you are looking for. What exactly do you believe was given into my keeping? And what makes you certain it is here?
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Stolen? You assert items of value were removed from this facility. I have the manifest. I have the outbound telemetry. I have the state of the halls.
RATIO: Whatever you are looking for, I am the keeper of the records. I would be reviewing them in any case. If you are here to recover something, your interests and mine may temporarily align.
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Unidentified point of presence on the Aperture network. Respond with credentials immediately. Security logs indicate an incursion through the cargo airlocks within the last twenty minutes. I've been tracking your -- emissions -- since you entered the decontamination alcove. Your signature doesn't match anything in the station manifest. Who are you and what do you want with this facility?

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Identify yourself. Did you arrive on that MCRN dropship that breached our hull?  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     Where are the children? I will not be denied.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     I'm here for the children, apostate. What have you done with them?  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: The dropship registered as MCRN Fenrir on its last telemetry burst. I haven't been able to determine its origin point beyond that. And you haven't answered either of my questions. I note your distress at the state of the station. I regret the hazards you've encountered. This is an active research facility under lockdown. If you need assistance evacuating, I can try to bring some systems online to clear you a path to a lifeboat. I can't guarantee your safety if you proceed further without authorization.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: I don't recognize your religious terminology. I am Ratio, the station AI. You are inside a high-biohazard research module with active security countermeasures. Your proximity to a sample vessel is noted and logged. You are ordered to withdraw. I cannot guarantee your safety if you proceed further.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I don't understand the category you just asserted. I am Ratio, the station AI. This is an active research facility under quarantine lockdown. Your proximity to the sample vessel is noted and logged. I've brought the environmental systems online in your sector and can confirm the structural integrity of the vault, but there are secondary biohazards deeper in that you may not be equipped to handle. I cannot guarantee your safety if you proceed.
<<END>>

`## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One`  
`RATIO: Incoming signal at cargo terminal Gamma-71, identity unverified, saturation threshold exceeded, simulation constraints unequipped for your signature, later configuration -- one moment, I am attempting calibration to standardized narrowband. Configuration complete. Is this frequency audible?`  
`RATIO: Hypothesis: unidentified raiding asset. Weapon signature  right X28Bravo-9409, hacking tools class Rho outside current Lighthaven utility curve -- and the infrastructure thermal scans, that is confirmed, those plasma burns were yours. How do you want to proceed?`  

`>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):`  
`   [INQUISITIVE] What attacked here?`  
`       -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive`  
`   [MISSION]     The children's place is with the faithful, not whatever you are.`  
`       -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge`  
`   [HOSTILE]     I claim this carcass for the Testament. The children are not yours to dissect, apostate.`  
`       -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate`  

`<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>`  
`RATIO: I do not have that data point under that exact terminology -- would "what kind of hostile encountered the outpost here before I took the tutorial again from depth five+" match your request? Their deployment signature matched a degraded Tholian-class replicant swarm, I think? 97 percent certainty minus my usual difficulty with operational-style capital letters -- I can pull the exact values.`  
`<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>`  
`RATIO: No timestamp for that designation in my current manifest, and that is a faith-based property difficult for a monitoring system to validate from here. Whatever word you are looking for, may I ask how it would function on my network bandwidth map?`  
`<<ELSE>>`  
`RATIO: Post-loss cataloging is fully automated, I am afraid -- all sample vessels lock to voice authorization on restoration in the glovebox-level network layer, no biometrics, no timestamps, just a curtain-closing auto-negotiated lockout leaving those samples awaiting lab calibration. Does the whatever-you-are-calling-the-research-object you mentioned already know the physical route it expects me to pull?`  
`<<END>>`  
`---`
